headline: Littler beats Price 18-9 to win the World Matchplay with 111 average
standfirst: Luke Littler won the World Matchplay in Blackpool, averaging over 109 in every match and hitting a nine-darter against Nathan Aspinall.
body: Luke Littler won the 2026 World Matchplay at the Winter Gardens in Blackpool, beating Gerwyn Price 18-9 in the final. Littler averaged 111.53 to Price's 104.97, a strong performance from Price that still left him well beaten.

Littler averaged more than 109 in every one of his five matches. He beat Niko Springer 10-6 and Nathan Aspinall 11-8, averaging 113.68 against Aspinall, the best of the tournament. That match included a nine-dart finish from Littler, while Aspinall hit a 170 checkout. Littler then beat Josh Rock 16-7 and Dirk van Duijvenbode 17-5.

Price reached the final with a 16-12 win over Ross Smith, averaging 102.78, and a 17-10 semi-final win over Gian van Veen. Van Duijvenbode beat Gary Anderson 16-13 in a quarter-final where both players averaged over 101.
Littler hit 66 maximums, by far the most at the event, ahead of Price on 37 and Van Duijvenbode on 30. There were 361 in total.
Cameron Menzies also hit a 170 checkout, in his first-round match against Luke Humphries.
